profile_text.body:
Craft Ventures is a for-profit venture capital firm headquartered in San Francisco, California, operating its own site at craftventures.com. The material on that site centers on its investing activity rather than on products of its own. The company describes a third investment in Horizon3, backing a $250M Series E at a $2B+ valuation, and frames autonomous AI hacking as becoming critical for continuous security validation, which it says is trusted by 7,000+ organizations including four Fortune 10 companies.

That is the extent of the AI-related position visible in the site text: an investor's stake in an AI security company, described in the company's own marketing terms. No products are tracked for Craft Ventures itself, and no MCP servers are listed.

On the record-keeping side, no lawsuits are listed against the company. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
